about_the_game:
metrocity is a grid based city building simulation game that has interesting and unique gameplay. in this game you will be the mayor who manages and builds your city from 0 to become a metropolis city with a population of thousands of people. You can arrange members of your government to help you in managing your city. Here are some of the features included in this demo version, such as:

1. Ray tracing technology

2. Time cycle 

3. Road infrastructure

4. Zone building system like Residential,Commercial and Industrial 

5. Water tower and Sewage outflow

6. Wind Turbine and Coal Power Plant

7. Fire station and Police station

8. School and university

9. Clinic

10. Industrial and Resources Extraction

11. Town hall and Construction Office

12. Economy simulation like trade or taxes.

Some of the enhanced features will be available in the full release version of the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 20H1
  • Processor: Core i5 6600 or Ryzen 5 1500x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 21H2 Above or Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i5 12600k or Ryzen 7 5700x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 or Radeon RX 6600XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

short_description: Play the Metrocity demo to begin your journey with Metrocity and prove your ability to manage and create the world's greatest city. Grow your city from zero to thousands of people in this game.
